7 · ENTRY — FROM PHASE 2
• champion baseline + focal design — module 5
• F2 (β = 2) contract + experiment table — module 6
• feature stores: 1y graph + time · 5y 2015–2018
• blind stores: Q4 2015 (1y) · 2019 (5y) — LOCKED
• team_focal v1.5 — imported, never copied
this sheet expands the dashed
"PHASE 3 — FINE-TUNING" box, same style
from Phase 2 —
champion baseline
8 · CONFIG & GO GATE
• CONFIG echo — STAGE 3m | 1y | 5y · TASK = binary (C = 2)
• MODELS · N_TRIALS · STUDY_TAG (_xcv appended in CV mode)
• DRIVING_METRIC = f2_c1, guarded by C0_FLOOR = 0.80
• USE_EXPANDING_CV · STREAM_PROPORTIONS · RUN_BLIND
• CONFIRM_RUN = True only after echo review — armed
one knob per decision — nothing hidden downstream;
clearing this gate arms the studies
9 · DATASTAGE — LOAD · REPAIR · TARGET · SPLIT
• Delta load → weather string repair (T / VRB → numeric)
• _ensure_target — BINARY delay_class: delayed ≥ 15 min;
nulls (cancellations) dropped
• leak-free time split train < val_start ≤ val — or year folds (11)
• TRAIN-only artifacts: indexer · medians · μ/σ · focal priors · ν
• sequence axis TAIL_NUM on the UTC spine — P(delay | prev
leg delayed) = 0.49 vs 0.12 base
one unit owns the target definition — plates stay task-blind
10 · STUDY RUNNER — ORCHESTRATION
• OPTIMIZATION PLATFORMS — Optuna: one study per variant,
hpo_{stage}_{variant}_{tag} · TPE (multivariate, group) + Hyperband
Hyperopt: Log Reg + XGBoost lanes — works with MLlib out of the box
• SQLite on /local_disk0 (ephemeral) ⇆ auto-restore newest team sync
• MLflow: study parent run → nested trial runs (live curves)
• driving value: f2_c1 × min(1, f2_c0 / 0.80) — macro F2 selectable
trials run sequentially — exactly one process owns the store
fold plan
windows(K) · priors · ν
imbalance policy per lane
11 · EXPANDING CROSS-VALIDATION — YEAR FOLDS (5y)
• USE_EXPANDING_CV = True replaces the single STAGE_BOUNDS split
• fold 1 — train 2015 → val 2016
• fold 2 — train 2015–2016 → val 2017
• fold 3 — train 2015–2017 → val 2018
• each trial fits ONCE PER FOLD; the study maximizes the MEAN drive
value across folds — folds cut on YEAR, not the UTC spine
• fold 4 (train 2015–2018 → 2019) is NOT a tuning fold — that role is
the winner refit (pool) + the gated blind (16)
the blind store never enters the search — CV and single-split values never share a study
12 · MOSAICML STREAMING (MDS) — SEQUENCE STORE
• SequenceWindowStore builds per-tail windows(K) once per (stage, fold, K)
→ MDS shards on DBFS · bounded driver memory, no full collect
• StreamingDataset feeds every rank — shards resolved per rank, not broadcast
• stores are WRITE-ONCE + skip-guard, versioned by MDS_TAG; nothing deletes
• TRAIN_EPOCH_SIZE caps the epoch → denser pruning checkpoints, less work
lost per spot preemption
• ν scaling (DeepAR §3.3): gap channel ÷ per-tail TRAIN-range mean gap
the loader is the seam — resampling, epoch size and scale all live here
13 · CLASS IMBALANCE — EITHER / OR (NEVER BOTH)
EITHER — UNDERSAMPLING
• XGBoost · MLP · Log Reg
• majority downsampled before the fit;
plain log loss / CE objective
OR
OR — FOCAL LOSS
• XGBoost (focal) · LSTM
• α_t + per-class γ (length 2);
class prior enters via the bias / margin
• LSTM lane only: proportional under/over-sampling at the loader —
STREAM_PROPORTIONS [0.70, 0.30] mixes the streams to a chosen rate
• resample XOR α — the focal bias init derives from the SAME proportions,
so the model's prior always matches the stream it actually sees
one correction per lane — never two dials fixing the same imbalance
14 · TRIAL EXECUTION — MODEL PLATES (CORE OF PHASE 3)
⟳ repeated × N_TRIALS per study · × folds per trial · one study per model
binary throughout (C = 2) — each plate names its own objective and its own imbalance lever; team_focal v1.5 is the single focal seam
LOG REG — LOG LOSS
DISTRIBUTED
• Spark MLlib LogisticRegression on the assembled frame —
executors train (true cluster training)
• objective: plain log loss — NO focal hook in this lane
• imbalance lever: UNDERSAMPLING of the majority class
• search: Hyperopt (TPE) — MLlib-native, no custom seam
• numeric block: impute → assemble → standardize
• decision: P(delayed) → tuned threshold τ
the interpretable baseline lane
XGBOOST — FOCAL | WEIGHTED CE
SINGLE DRIVER
• FOCAL variant — custom objective + base_margin on the
driver; natural rate, NO resampling (prior in the bias)
• WEIGHTED-CE variant — undersampled majority, plain
weighted cross-entropy, Hyperopt search on MLlib
• eval_metric: macro F2 / f2_c1 on margins (cfg.predict)
• tree_method hist · live curve logger every 5 rounds
• pruning key discovered from the val eval set
two objectives, one architecture — the controlled loss comparison
MLP — SOFTMAX CE
DISTRIBUTED
• Spark ML MultilayerPerceptronClassifier — executors
train (true cluster training) · softmax cross-entropy
• no focal hook — no custom-loss seam in MLPC
• imbalance lever: UNDERSAMPLING of the majority class
• numeric block: impute → assemble → standardize
• honestly unpruned (no mid-fit hook);
objectiveHistory logged after the fit
• output layer = 2
honest CE comparison lane
LSTM — FOCAL LOSS (MDS)
DISTRIBUTED
• variants: lstm_standard (1 layer, Adam) ·
lstm_stacked (3 layers, AdamW)
• TorchDistributor = launcher, not trainer — Spark seats
N ranks → torch.distributed (gloo | nccl)
• StreamingDataset shards MDS windows per rank;
DDP all-reduces gradients every step
• imbalance lever: proportional stream resampling —
focal bias init derives from the same vector
• rank-0: epoch eval → DBFS pruning channel (STOP);
state_dict → driver rebuild + val scoring
• head width = 1 logit (binary)
the sequence lane — per-tail rotation chains
per trial, every plate: space(trial) → loss cfg (α_t · per-class γ, length 2 — focal lanes only) → fit ONCE PER FOLD (11) → Evaluator.suite (weighted F2 · macro F2 · c0 · c1) per fold
→ MEAN drive value across folds → nested MLflow run (params · live curves · suite · loss cfg) → returned to the search — TPE learns, Hyperband prunes
suite · fold means · Best3 · live curves
15 · EVALUATION & SELECTION
• Evaluator suite: weighted F2 · macro F2 · per-class c0 | c1 (binary contract)
• Best3 tracker per study → trial leaderboard (storage-discovered — every STUDY_TAG appears)
• winner refit on the pool = last fold's train + val (2015–2018) before anything blind
• threshold τ chosen on the pool validation split (2018 natural rate):
max f2_c1 subject to f2_c0 ≥ 0.80 — frozen BEFORE the blind is touched
• persist: pytorch / native booster / spark flavor + raw-bias artifact + PREDICT_NOTE → MLflow
• acceptance gate: reload from MLflow must reproduce the logged value (tol 1e-6)
every trial also lands as a row in the experiment log — module 6's table, continued
16 · BLIND — GATED (SCORED ONCE)
• opens only when RUN_BLIND = True and STAGE is
• winner scored once per lane, at the frozen τ
• TRAIN-fitted artifacts only (indexer · medians · μ/σ · ν)
• the blind year is never a CV fold — it never touches
tuning, spaces, folds, or selection
the Phase 2 lock, finally consumed
FINAL — PHASE 3 DELIVERABLE
• selected model + tuned config (study winner, refit on the pool)
• frozen operating point τ + the decision rule it encodes
• full experiment table — MLflow runs + experiment-log rows
• per-fold and mean CV values — the generalization evidence
• blind metrics — reported exactly once
• report + presentation hand-off (metric tables · figures · runtime per model)
opened by the champion baseline from module 5 — closed by the blind gate
winner refit + τ
blind metrics — once
iterate — next rung: STAGE 3m → 1y → 5y · new STUDY_TAG (fresh study) · reshaped spaces · sampling policy
RECONCILIATION — PHASE 2 SHEET → THIS SHEET
• module 5 (champion + focal design) → entry (7) · model plates (14)
• module 6 (F2 contract, experiment table) → Evaluator suite + experiment log (15)
• "HPO platform: Optuna or W&B" → Optuna TPE + Hyperband (LSTM) · Hyperopt on MLlib (Log Reg, XGBoost) (10)
• "MLP + advanced models" → MLP · LSTM (14)
• "cross-validation" → expanding year folds, mean drive across folds (11)
• "class imbalance strategy" → either/or block: undersampling XOR focal (13)
• "model selection" → Best3 → refit → τ → acceptance (15)
• "full-scale training" → staged rungs 3m → 1y → 5y (8–16) on MDS streaming (12)
• "blind evaluation" → blind gate (16) — once
• checkpoint discipline → persistence strip (below)
PERSISTENCE DISCIPLINE (PHASE 3 OBJECTIVE)

Persist after every stage — Optuna SQLite → timestamped team-store syncs (restart-proof) · MDS stores write-once under MDS_TAG, reused by skip-guard · MLflow: params + live curves + per-fold suite + loss cfg
· best-3 models + raw-bias artifacts + predict notes · frozen τ · experiment-log rows · all paths recorded in the report appendix
